description: Get the full text of one guide or reference page by its slug from listGuides. For a guide, sections holds the steps in order: each names the page, menu, button or field to use in the web app, with extra detail about what it does. Use when: listGuides shows an entry that covers what the person wants to do. The steps are for a person using the web app to follow; this tool does none of them. An unknown slug returns 404.

slug.description: A slug from the guide list.

name: getGuide

kind.description: `guide` is a step-by-step walkthrough of the web app. `reference` is a page of facts such as pricing.

slug.description: The name to pass to getGuide.

summary.example: Script a call step by step and check the IVR answers correctly

sections.description: The text in order, as markdown. For a guide, one entry per numbered step.

title: Get a UI Guide
